{#- The current page's ancestors, root first, then its own title unlinked. Shown only for a page below the top level of the tree. -#} {%- if tree and tree.current and tree.ancestors %}
    {%- for a in tree.ancestors %}
  1. {{ a.title }}
    2. {%- endfor %}
  2. {{ tree.current.title }}
{%- endif %}
